# arl_op_oc {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
arl_op_oc(op_dgp, lam, cl, reps=10_000; chart_choice, d=1, m=3, ced=false, ad=100,
  rl_max=typemax(Int))
```
Compute the out-of-control average run length (ARL) of the EWMA chart based on ordinal patterns via simulation, following Weiß and Testik (2023). The computation is multithreaded.
 
  * `op_dgp`: out-of-control DGP (e.g. [`AR1`](AR1.qmd), [`MA1`](MA1.qmd), [`MA2`](MA2.qmd), [`TEAR1`](TEAR1.qmd), [`QAR1`](QAR1.qmd)).
  * `lam::Float64`: smoothing parameter of the EWMA statistic.
  * `cl::Float64`: control limit of the chart.
  * `reps::Int=10_000`: number of replications.
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`Shannon()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon), [`ShannonExtropy()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), [`DistanceToWhiteNoise()`](DistanceToWhiteNoise.qmd), [`UpDownBalance()`](UpDownBalance.qmd), [`Persistence()`](Persistence.qmd), [`RotationalAsymmetry()`](RotationalAsymmetry.qmd), [`UpDownScaling()`](UpDownScaling.qmd) (see [`chart_stat_op`](chart_stat_op.qmd)). For [`Shannon`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) and [`ShannonExtropy`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), the statistic is in the logarithm base of the chart, which must be larger than 1. Both default to base 2 in ComplexityMeasures.jl; use [`Shannon(base=exp(1))`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) for the natural logarithm used in the papers. The control limit `cl` must be given in the same base.
  * `d::Int=1`: delay between observations of a pattern.
  * `m::Int=3`: length of the ordinal patterns.
  * `ced::Bool=false`: use conditional expected delay initialization.
  * `ad::Int=100`: number of in-control iterations for `ced`.
  * `rl_max::Int=typemax(Int)`: maximal run length after which a replication is stopped.
Returns the tuple `(ARL, standard error)`.
 


:::
